movie_preferences.text: I enjoy science fiction movies that explore future technology and space.
I like romantic comedies with lighthearted, feel-good storylines.
I'm drawn to war dramas that portray historical conflicts.
I enjoy classic film noir and crime mysteries with morally ambiguous characters.
I enjoy horror and thriller movies that build suspense.

trait_framings.sentence: I love discovering new ideas and experiences that challenge how I usually see things. I get restless with the same old routines.
I prefer familiar routines and practical, down-to-earth things. Abstract or experimental ideas don't really appeal to me in general.
I like being organized, planning ahead, and following through carefully on things I start.
I tend to be spontaneous and easygoing, and I don't worry about planning things out in detail.
I'm energized by being around people and I really enjoy lively, sociable situations with others.
I'm more reserved and quiet, and I prefer calm, low-key situations over big social gatherings.
I try to be warm, cooperative, and considerate of other people's feelings and needs.
I tend to be skeptical and blunt with others, and I don't usually accommodate people.
I tend to worry a lot and get stressed or anxious fairly easily.
I'm generally calm, emotionally stable, and don't get rattled easily.
